notes: Method: every claim was re-queried against the live DB at localhost:5433 (schema provenance), and where the DB lacked a table I went to the archived artifact on disk rather than declaring the claim unverifiable. That single change of method flipped 9 of the 12 INSUFFICIENT_DATA verdicts to CONFIRMED. Three systematic first-pass errors account for almost all of them: (a) filtering provenance.runs.model, which holds FORECAST model names, when looking for LLM models -- this hid the entire 26-run 235B-TP8 sweep (lines 380, 526); (b) reading llm_run_summary.p99_itl_ms where tab:val-anchor's definition maps to p99_tpot_ms -- this manufactured an 8 ms 'discrepancy' that does not exist (lines 537, 538); (c) treating 'not in the DB' as 'not verifiable', when the live aiperf exports, the manager.jsonl replica-time logs, the 560-cell target-time grid, the 4x-payload sensitivity replay, and the SOL fallback trace are all archived on disk (lines 311, 476, 514, 516, 536, 539). Only ONE genuine thesis defect survived adversarial scrutiny: line 253's +24%, which traces to a misprinted polynomial p99 cell in tab:sim-poly-aic (248 for the archived 249.441). I proved this by identifying both table columns to their exact artifacts and matching 5 and 8 independent cells respectively, and by checking that the same-batch pair in the DB gives +23.0% while the cross-batch pair gives +23.2% -- neither route can produce +24%. Two claims remain genuinely undecidable and I upheld them as INSUFFICIENT_DATA with explicit NO-EDIT instructions: the 21.4M forecast-row count (bracketed by the on-disk archive at 21.6-22.0M but not exactly reproducible without the author's inclusion rule) and the ~17% unlocked-clock inflation (the unlocked dataset was recollected and overwritten; the surviving proxies disagree with each other, 11-19% versus 27%, so none of them justifies a number change -- if it must be addressed, weaken the prose rather than restate the figure). Three follow-on defects OUTSIDE this chapter were uncovered and are flagged for their own chapter reviews, not acted on here: twopool.tex:76-82's 235B TTFT/ITL figures (398/1,402/87.7) reproduce from no artifact I could find; twopool.tex tab:sim-poly-aic's polynomial cells 248 and 67.3 should be 249 and 67.4; and validation.tex:72's -7.6% should be -7.7% (unrounded -7.6654%).
